pitfalls.summary: Redirect rules are captured at discovery into state/url-preservation/source-redirects.ndjson with per-provider coverage in source-redirect-coverage.json. Backend import never writes them to Wix: the redirect helpers (url-redirects.js plan/apply/verify) install and check them after the website exists, timed by cutover. The capability stays pending until that path is live-verified.

Yoast Premium keeps its redirects in the wp_options table, which the bridge always denies. Coverage is unsupported until the operator supplies Yoast's redirect CSV export (SEO > Redirects > Import/Export); per-post SEO meta stays with the wordpress-seo profile.
